sql_calls.sql:
SELECT audit_ts, status
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY audit_ts;

SELECT d.date, d.units_sold, d.revenue_inr,
       f.forecast_units_per_day, f.sigma, f.book_on_hand AS forecast_book_on_hand,
       i.book_on_hand_close,
       a.status AS audit_status, a.audit_ts
FROM store.daily_sales d
LEFT JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.sku = d.sku AND f.date = d.date
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book i ON i.sku = d.sku AND i.date = d.date
LEFT JOIN store.shelf_audits a ON a.sku = d.sku AND a.audit_ts::date = d.date
WHERE d.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND d.date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND d.date < DATE '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY d.date;

SELECT
  (SELECT MIN(bill_ts) FROM store.pos_lines) AS pos_min_ts,
  (SELECT MAX(bill_ts) FROM store.pos_lines) AS pos_max_ts,
  (SELECT MIN(date) FROM store.daily_sales) AS sales_min_date,
  (SELECT MAX(date) FROM store.daily_sales) AS sales_max_date,
  (SELECT MIN(date) FROM store.inventory_book) AS inventory_min_date,
  (SELECT MAX(date) FROM store.inventory_book) AS inventory_max_date,
  (SELECT MIN(date) FROM store.forecasts) AS forecast_min_date,
  (SELECT MAX(date) FROM store.forecasts) AS forecast_max_date;

SELECT count_ts, book_before, counted, adjustment, trigger
FROM store.stock_counts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY count_ts;

SELECT date, units, reason
FROM store.write_offs
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY date;

SELECT
  (SELECT MIN(bill_ts) FROM store.pos_lines) AS pos_min_ts,
  (SELECT MAX(bill_ts) FROM store.pos_lines) AS pos_max_ts,
  (SELECT MIN(date) FROM store.daily_sales) AS sales_min_date,
  (SELECT MAX(date) FROM store.daily_sales) AS sales_max_date,
  (SELECT MIN(date) FROM store.inventory_book) AS inventory_min_date,
  (SELECT MAX(date) FROM store.inventory_book) AS inventory_max_date,
  (SELECT MIN(date) FROM store.forecasts) AS forecast_min_date,
  (SELECT MAX(date) FROM store.forecasts) AS forecast_max_date,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.stock_counts WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG') AS atta_stock_counts;

SELECT count_ts, book_before, counted, adjustment, trigger
FROM store.stock_counts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY count_ts;

sql_calls.sql:
WITH june_sales AS (
  SELECT date, units_sold, revenue_inr
  FROM store.daily_sales
  WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
    AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
), audits AS (
  SELECT audit_ts::date AS date, status
  FROM store.shelf_audits
  WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
    AND audit_ts >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < DATE '2026-07-01'
), empty_days AS (
  SELECT a.date, s.units_sold, f.forecast_units_per_day
  FROM audits a
  JOIN june_sales s ON s.date = a.date
  JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND f.date = a.date
  WHERE a.status = 'empty'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM june_sales) AS bags_sold,
  (SELECT MIN(date) FROM june_sales) AS sales_from,
  (SELECT MAX(date) FROM june_sales) AS sales_to,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audits) AS audit_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audits WHERE status = 'on shelf') AS on_shelf_audits,
  ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audits WHERE status = 'on shelf') / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audits), 1) AS on_shelf_availability_pct,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM empty_days) AS audited_empty_days,
  (SELECT SUM(forecast_units_per_day) FROM empty_days) AS estimated_lost_bags_on_audited_empty_days,
  (SELECT SUM(forecast_units_per_day) * 265.0 FROM empty_days) AS estimated_lost_revenue_inr;

SELECT date_trunc('day', bill_ts)::date AS sales_date,
       MIN(bill_ts) AS first_sale, MAX(bill_ts) AS last_sale,
       COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(qty) AS units
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND bill_ts >= DATE '2026-06-08'
  AND bill_ts < DATE '2026-06-29'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT SUM(qty) AS bags_sold,
       MIN(bill_ts)::date AS first_sales_date,
       MAX(bill_ts)::date AS last_sales_date
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND bill_ts >= DATE '2026-06-01'
  AND bill_ts < DATE '2026-07-01';

WITH june AS (
  SELECT d.date, d.units_sold, f.forecast_units_per_day, f.book_on_hand,
         i.book_on_hand_close,
         a.status AS audit_status
  FROM store.daily_sales d
  JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.sku = d.sku AND f.date = d.date
  LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book i ON i.sku = d.sku AND i.date = d.date
  LEFT JOIN store.shelf_audits a ON a.sku = d.sku AND a.audit_ts::date = d.date
  WHERE d.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
    AND d.date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND d.date < DATE '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT
  SUM(forecast_units_per_day) AS total_forecast_units,
  SUM(units_sold) AS actual_units,
  SUM(forecast_units_per_day) - SUM(units_sold) AS forecast_minus_actual,
  SUM(forecast_units_per_day) FILTER (WHERE audit_status = 'empty') AS forecast_on_empty_audit_days,
  SUM(forecast_units_per_day) FILTER (WHERE units_sold = 0) AS forecast_on_zero_sales_days,
  SUM(forecast_units_per_day - units_sold) FILTER (WHERE units_sold = 0) AS shortfall_on_zero_sales_days,
  SUM(forecast_units_per_day - units_sold) FILTER (WHERE date IN (DATE '2026-06-11', DATE '2026-06-12', DATE '2026-06-23', DATE '2026-06-24', DATE '2026-06-25', DATE '2026-06-26')) AS shortfall_in_possible_stockout_periods
FROM june;
